Super Probiotics PlatinumProbiotics · Gut health

Made by E&S · Once a day · 1 stick per serving

The labelled standard for this product is at least 100 million CFU per 2000mg. The weight of one stick is not stated in the official text, so this page does not calculate a per-stick count. Probiotics are recognized by Korea's MFDS as an ingredient that may help promote lactic acid bacteria growth and suppress harmful bacteria, may help support smooth bowel movement, and may help support gut health.

Why this product

  • The labelled standard for this product is at least 100 million CFU per 2000mg
  • The weight of one stick is not stated in the official text, so this page does not calculate a per-stick count
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by E&S

Officially recognised functions

  • May help with increasing lactic acid bacteria and suppressing harmful bacteria
  • May help with smooth bowel movements; may help with gut health

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 stick per serving

Labelled standard

Probiotic count at least 100 million CFU per 2000mg
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연분홍색에 입자성이 있는 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 18개월
Storage 직사광선 및 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a medical condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children and follow the stated daily intake · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · This health functional food is not a drug for preventing or treating disease; consult a pharmacist or professional in store
